name: Ba'ken's entourage droid
description: Ba'ken's entourage droid served as a levitating guard droid for the alien Ba'ken on the planet Zenarita. It had red sensors on a cylindrical grey-plated head and body with an orange-colored sphere protruding from the bottom. The front of its body had two buttons and two compartment hatches. One of the hatches housed a three-pronged arm that could extend out and hold a blaster.
